text: Joon Whitfield’s red card at 43 minutes left Harbour City down to ten men against Seabrook Town while the score remained 0-0 [#871]. Harbour City had been controlling possession and the field, using a patient short passing style in a 4-2-3-1, but their less aggressive pressing (PPDA 12.5) allowed Seabrook’s wide, crossing-focused 3-4-3 to stretch their lines and force risky defensive actions. This dismissal disrupts Harbour City's structured buildup and will require tactical adjustments to maintain defensive solidity against Seabrook’s wide threat. The key coaching point is to emphasize disciplined defensive positioning to avoid fouls that risk red cards when under wide, high-pressure attacks.
